lines.text: Chats in one app. Docs in another. Tasks, somewhere in between.
Every switch costs focus, and the important things slip through the cracks.
Meet Kitewise. One calm workspace, with an AI that keeps it all connected.
Kitewise plugs into the tools you already use, so every message, file and task lands in a single feed.
No more hunting. Just open it, and you're caught up.
Need the short version? Ask Kite.
It reads the whole thread and hands you a summary, with the decisions and next steps pulled out.
Then turn those next steps into tasks, with one click.
Kitewise assigns owners, sets due dates, and keeps the board in sync on its own.
Less switching. More finished work. And a team that always knows what's next.
Kitewise. Your work, in one view. Try it free at kitewise dot app.
